education_bites:
SIP is a method of investing regularly.

It does not remove market risk.

Your finance meme just became educational.

Volatility: price moves.

Risk: the chance of an adverse outcome.

Not every red candle is the same thing.

Price: what the market quotes.
Value: what you believe an asset is worth.

The two can disagree.

Diversification: not owning everything.

It is spreading exposure so one mistake does not dominate the whole portfolio.

Asset can be valuable.

But if you need cash today, liquidity suddenly matters a lot.
